verdict.rationale: Docs explicitly confirm several core workflows can be done via either the UI or the API with equivalent effect: creating subscriptions (orb-docs-8), editing subscriptions/pricing 'directly from Orb's web interface or via the API' (orb-docs-31), and invoice issuance 'via the dashboard or API' (orb-docs-34). This shows real UI/API parity for key billing actions, but there is no blanket documentation claiming full parity across every UI feature (e.g. alert setup, plan template management, dashboards/reporting UI). Missing for 10: explicit parity statements for all UI surfaces (reporting, alerts, plan catalog management) and independent confirmation that no UI-only features exist.
